messages:
mira: quick triage: nebula-36k-int8 onboarding shows micro-token spacing diff after shard handoff; fails strict goldset.
dan: short repro? flags? seeds?
mira: prefill ~22k tokens, trigger shard swap, resume -> pos 22107: expected="." got=". ". Happens ~25% on int8 canary, not on fp16.
sophia: try toggling prefix_cache=global and DISABLE_PREFIX_CACHE=1
mira: global helps (drop to ~5%), disable almost removes it. chunk_size 1024 worse than 2048.
dan: could be quant rounding at KV write with RoPE index near wrap. add kvcache checksums and rotary-index hash on handoff.
mira: added small harness and seed in repo -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/kv-triage/nebula-36k
rookie-kv-bot: build: canary nebula-36k-int8-20240501 queued on qa-dedicated
sophia: assign INF-5010, label kv-handshake. I'll run matrix int8/int4/fp16 x cache modes x chunk sizes tomorrow and post results.
dan: if consistent, mitigation: handshake metadata + fallback to re-prefill. less perf but safe.
mira: thanks, will watch INF-5010 and attach logs.
